advancements.steveparty.guide.lay_the_bo: Place a Tile, an Advanced Tile or a Checkpoint
advancements.steveparty.guide.make_a_paw: Get a Tokenizer Wand or a Token
advancements.steveparty.guide.mini_games: Get a Mini-Game Page or place a Mini-game Controller
Get a Shopkeeper Key or place a Trading Stall
advancements.steveparty.guide.root.descr: Get Plastic Pellets or a first board item
advancements.steveparty.guide.root.title: Steve Party Maker
[#](1F5F99)**Redstone**[#]() picks the cartridge that plays.\
\
Power 0 = slot 1, 1 = slot 2…

Role, colour and destinations follow the active cartridge.\
\
A comparator or a counter: the space changes every turn.
book.steveparty.guide.board.board_view.p:
[#](1F5F99)**Linker Brush**[#]() in hand: every link shows.
- [#](1F5F99)**Start**[#]()
- [#](B8860B)**?**[#]() at forks
- [#](C0392B)**!**[#]() at dead ends
- [#](D2691E)**!**[#]() if unreachable

[#](1F5F99)**Wrench**[#]() on the [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#](), or [#](9A6A00)/steveparty board check[#]().\
\
No start, dead ends, empty shops…
book.steveparty.guide.board.explorer_hel:
- A panel on each space within 8 blocks
- Its destinations in [#](2E7D32)**green**[#]()
- What leads there in [#](2A62C9)**blue**[#]()
- Its chests in [#](B8860B)**gold**[#]()
[#](9A6A00)G[#](): turns its lamp on or off. It doesn't protect.
- [#](1F5F99)**Play**[#](), empty hand: the panel
- [#](1F5F99)**Build**[#](), tool in hand: the settings
- [#](1F5F99)**Explorer**[#](), helmet on: the whole board
book.steveparty.guide.board.linking.desc: Paint the path with the brush
book.steveparty.guide.board.linking.name: Linking Spaces
book.steveparty.guide.board.linking.page:
[#](9A6A00)Hold right-click[#]() and sweep the spaces along the path.\
\
Sweep a link again: [#](C0392B)**erased**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Left-click[#](): its wheel.
- [#](1F5F99)**Default link**[#]() or [#](1F5F99)**by power**[#]()
- [#](1F5F99)**Mode**[#](): keep or put a cartridge
- [#](1F5F99)**Undo**[#]() / [#](1F5F99)**Redo**[#]()

- to a [#](1F5F99)**space**[#](): a destination
- to a [#](1F5F99)**chest**[#](): its storage
- to a [#](1F5F99)**Spawn Bubble**[#](): where its mob appears
- to a [#](1F5F99)**Magpie Nest**[#](): the pot

[#](3E8E2E)**[Linker]**[#](): makes links.\
[#](5E9A50)**[Linkable]**[#](): can be linked.\
\
Brush in off hand: each tile placed links to the last one.
book.steveparty.guide.board.moving.name: Moving on the Board
book.steveparty.guide.board.moving.page1:
Arrows appear: [#](9A6A00)right-click empty-handed[#]() on one.\
\
No steps left: the space triggers for the whole party.
book.steveparty.guide.board.name: The Board
book.steveparty.guide.board.placing.name: Placing Tiles
book.steveparty.guide.board.placing.page: It faces one of [#](1F5F99)**8 directions**[#](), following your look.

Tokens climb the slopes.

- On stairs: a ramp
- On a stair corner: diagonal
- On a slab, snow or carpet: on their surface
book.steveparty.guide.board.router.name: Redstone Router
book.steveparty.guide.board.router.page0:
Its destinations: the spaces it drives.\
\
Its power [#](1F5F99)**replaces**[#]() theirs: one lever, a whole board.
book.steveparty.guide.board.router.page1:
- 15 plain · 14 bonus · 13 penalty
- 11 start · 10 Stop · 9 Roll Again
- 8 Teleport · 7 forward · 6 back
- 5 shop · 1 a token passes
book.steveparty.guide.board.sizes.name: Tile Sizes
- [#](1F5F99)**Small**[#](): 1 block
- [#](1F5F99)**Standard**[#](): 2×2 picture on its block
- [#](1F5F99)**Large**[#](): 2×2 blocks
2 small = 1 standard; 4 standard in a square = 1 large.
- It keeps cartridges, settings, look, size
- It [#](C0392B)**loses its links**[#]()
- With [#](2E7D32)**Silk Touch**[#](): links kept
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.name: Tiles & Checkpoints
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page0: A board is made of spaces. Their [#](1F5F99)**cartridges**[#]() give role and destinations.
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page1:
- [#](1F5F99)**Tile**[#](): 1 cartridge, 1 step
- [#](B8860B)**Advanced Tile**[#](): 16 cartridges, redstone picks
- [#](1F5F99)**Checkpoint**[#](): 16 cartridges, [#](2E7D32)**0 steps**[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page2: The recipe's cartridge stays inside, as it was.
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page3:
At a crafting table:
- Tile + cartridge: replaced
- Tile alone: emptied
- Advanced tile + cartridges: free slots filled
book.steveparty.guide.board.spaces.page4: A glass cube without collision: handy in bends.
book.steveparty.guide.board.spawn_bubble:
Where a space's mob appears, and where it looks.\
\
Link the space to the bubble with the [#](1F5F99)**Linker Brush**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() with the [#](1F5F99)**Wrench**[#]().
- [#](1F5F99)**On arrival**[#](): the mob comes on a stop
- [#](1F5F99)**Always visible**[#](): it lives on the board
- [#](1F5F99)**Height**[#](): -4 to +8
No bubble: next to its space. [#](9A6A00)Sneak + Wrench[#](): turns 22.5°.
book.steveparty.guide.board.stamping.des: Give a tile its own look
book.steveparty.guide.board.stamping.pag:
[#](1F5F99)**Stencil**[#]() + [#](1F5F99)**dye**[#]() (one per hand), [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a tile: pattern printed.\
\
Cost: 1 dye.

- [#](1F5F99)**Wet sponge**[#](): erases the stamp
- [#](1F5F99)**Dye**[#](): colours the active cartridge
- [#](1F5F99)**Glow ink**[#](): the tile glows; [#](1F5F99)**ink**[#](): off
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.name: Wrench
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.page0: [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() a space or a router: its cartridges open.
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.page1: It also sets podiums, poles and bubbles, and breaks plastic in one hit.
book.steveparty.guide.board.wrench.page2:
- [#](1F5F99)**Picker**[#](): copies a cartridge's destinations onto others
- Another cartridge in off hand: swapped, links kept
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.advance:
A token ending here moves on 1 to 6 spaces:\
[#](23933C)**forward**[#]() or [#](E23C9A)**back**[#]().

- [#](9A6A00)Sneak + scroll[#](), cartridge in hand: number and direction
- A [#](1F5F99)**Boomcart**[#]() pushes or rams the token
- No chaining
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.cartrid: A [#](1F5F99)**Cartridge**[#]() gives a space its role and its destinations.

Cartridge in hand, [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a block: it becomes a destination. Again: removed.

- 1 destination: a set path
- several: the player picks
- none: the token stops

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the air, cartridge in hand.\
\
Or open its space with the [#](1F5F99)**Wrench**[#](): the menu shows beside it.
Each role: this cartridge + one ingredient.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.invento: The token ends here: its player [#](2E7D32)**gets**[#]() or [#](C0392B)**loses**[#]() items.

- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() a chest: linked (up to 8)
- Its menu: 9 items, [#](9A6A00)scroll[#]() sets the count
- Below 1: [#](C0392B)**negative**[#](), the item is taken

No linked chest: the [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage.

- [#](2A62C9)**Blue**[#](): bonus
- [#](C0392B)**Red**[#](): penalty
- [#](D2691E)**Orange**[#](): nothing to give
Blue and red also make the mini-games' teams A and B.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.key_gat: Gates [#](109090)**lock**[#]() some of the space's exits.

A locked exit needs a [#](1F5F99)**Gate Key**[#]().

- Use it: spent, the gate opens
- No key: wait, replay the move or go back to start

- Each exit: [#](2E7D32)**Free**[#]() or [#](C0392B)**Key**[#]()
- Open for how many turns: [#](1F5F99)**0**[#]() closes again, [#](1F5F99)**10**[#]() forever
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.mistigr: A token stops here: the [#](1F5F99)**Mistigri**[#]()'s roulette draws a [#](C0392B)**sentence**[#]().

- [#](C0392B)**Steal**[#](): coins or stars
- [#](C0392B)**Redistribute**[#](): to others, poorest first
- [#](C0392B)**Back**[#](): 1 to 9 spaces
- [#](C0392B)**Cursed die**[#](): next roll 1 to 3
- [#](2E7D32)**Pity**[#](): coins given

- Up to **12** sentences
- Each: type, target, number or %%, [#](1F5F99)**weight**[#]() 0 to 9
- **5/8**: how many go on the roulette
What is stolen goes to the [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage; pity comes out of it.
The [#](1F5F99)**Mistigri's Die**[#]() drops from a Mistigri.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.name: Cartridges
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.pot.des: Feed the pot, win the pot
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.pot.pag: Passers [#](C0392B)**stake**[#](), whoever [#](2E7D32)**stops**[#]() wins the whole pot.

The pot is the coins in a [#](1F5F99)**Magpie Nest**[#]().\
\
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the nest with the cartridge to link it. A magpie fetches the stakes.

- [#](1F5F99)**Stake**[#](): 0 to 100 (default 1)
- [#](1F5F99)**Base**[#](): coins put back after each win
- [#](1F5F99)**Max**[#](): the cap
A token ends here on its turn: its player [#](2E7D32)**rolls again**[#]() at once.\
\
This extra turn never gives another.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.shop.pa: The token ends here: a [#](1F5F99)**Boxed Trader**[#]() opens shop.

- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the trader, or [#](9A6A00)[Open the shop][#]() in the chat
- Closes by itself after 60 s
- In a checkpoint: every token passing stops

- Its menu: up to [#](1F5F99)**9 offers**[#]()
- [#](9A6A00)Sneak + scroll[#](): purchases per stop
- Stock: its linked chests, else the [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage
Steal the [#](1F5F99)**Bandana**[#]() from a trader with shears.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.star.pa: The star waits on a [#](B8900A)**Star**[#]() space, held by a [#](1F5F99)**Mula**[#]().

A token reaching it stops.

- [#](9A6A00)[Buy][#]() or [#](9A6A00)[No thanks][#]() in the chat
- Bought anyway after 15 s
- Then the star moves to another space

- The [#](1F5F99)**price**[#]()
- Sold when passing or only when stopping
- Leaves a space turned off by redstone, or not

The star comes from the [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage; the coins paid go there.\
\
[#](C0392B)No star in storage: nothing is sold.[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.start.p:
A token set on a [#](4C9A2A)**Start**[#]() space binds to it.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() empty-handed: token and space are yours.
The [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#]() only takes bound tokens. Hit a token to unbind it.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.stop.pa: A token reaching a [#](454B5A)**Stop**[#]() space [#](C0392B)**ends**[#]() its move, steps left are lost.
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.telepor: The token ends here: it jumps to another [#](8E4BFF)**Teleport**[#]() space of the same colour.

- [#](8E4BFF)**Violet**[#]() (default), [#](2E7D32)**green**[#](), [#](D2691E)**orange**[#](), [#](2A62C9)**blue**[#]()
- A dye on the space changes its network
- Its menu: random or in turn
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.thresho: A wall: the token only gets through if [#](557799)**its roll**[#]() meets the condition.

Failed: the token [#](C0392B)**stops here**[#]() and loses its steps.\
\
Default: [#](2E7D32)**7 or more**[#]().

- [#](1F5F99)**Condition**[#](): ≥ ≤ > < = 1 to 30, Double, Triple
- [#](1F5F99)**Passage**[#](): tested each time
- [#](1F5F99)**Barrier**[#](): blocked, retry every turn
- [#](1F5F99)**Opening**[#](): for all, or per token
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.trichau: Pick a head, win its prize
A token stops here: the [#](EA600C)**Tricauldron**[#]() rises, [#](2E7D32)**one head per prize**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Hit[#]() or [#](9A6A00)click[#]() a head: it spits its prize at you.\
\
30 s, else at random.

- [#](1F5F99)**Prizes**[#](): up to 5 items
- [#](1F5F99)**Consumed**[#]() or [#](1F5F99)**Permanent**[#]()
- [#](1F5F99)**Blind**[#]() or [#](1F5F99)**True choice**[#]()
- Taken from its linked chests, else the [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#]()'s storage
book.steveparty.guide.cartridges.wicklin: A token stops here: a [#](3B1FB8)**Wickling**[#]() robs the victim of your choice.

Never more than the victim has.

- [#](C0392B)**Coins**[#](): 7 s to hit it, each hit takes one back
- [#](C0392B)**Stars**[#](): no defence
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.boomcart: A grumpy cart full of TNT
A grumpy living minecart, in mineshafts.

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() with the other: it swaps.

- [#](C0392B)**TNT**[#](): a real explosion
- [#](1F5F99)**Rocket**[#](): a burst of stars, harmless

[#](1F5F99)**Flint and steel**[#](): [#](C0392B)8 s[#]() to blast, it rushes to the nearest player.\
\
Another player relights it: [#](2E7D32)**+3 s**[#](), +2, +1.

[#](23933C)**Forward**[#]() space: it blasts the token on.\
[#](E23C9A)**Back**[#]() space: it rams it.\
\
No block broken, nobody hurt.
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.glandoui: A grumpy acorn, under oaks and in taigas.

Come close or annoy it: it stamps and [#](C0392B)**charges**[#]().\
\
It [#](2E7D32)**never hurts**[#](). Into a wall: dazed.

- [#](9A6A00)Jump[#]() on its hat: squashed
- Twice: it drops [#](1F5F99)**acorns**[#]()
- An acorn on farmland: a young one

Calm, they stack (up to 5).

- [#](9A6A00)Hit[#]() one in a tower: it flies off
- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() empty-handed: you carry them
- [#](9A6A00)Left-click[#](): you throw one

Rarely, it loses its [#](1F5F99)**Acorn Hat**[#]().

- [#](2E7D32)**Young**[#](): fast
- [#](1F5F99)**Old mossy**[#](): never charges
- [#](2A62C9)**Frosty**[#](): slides like a puck
A tower of [#](9A5A2A)**Slackorns**[#]() pushes the token a few spaces, with those it meets.

- [#](1F5F99)**Spaces**[#](): up to 50; below 0, [#](E23C9A)**backwards**[#]()
- Tower [#](1F5F99)**height**[#]()
- Each token met knocks one off
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.magpie.p:
In forests, in six colours.\
\
Hold [#](1F5F99)**seeds**[#](): they follow you.

By day, a magpie picks up a [#](1F5F99)**shiny item**[#]() on the ground and takes it to its nest.\
\
Never from your inventory.

Two magpies fed [#](1F5F99)**seeds**[#](): a [#](2E7D32)**chick**[#]().\
\
It takes the first free nest. Grown in 20 min.

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() with coins: stored. Empty hand: taken back.\
\
27 × 256. A comparator reads the pile.
Breaks fast with an axe or a hoe, contents kept.
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.mistigri: A fat black tomcat full of bad luck.

Near a [#](1F5F99)**witch hut**[#](), [#](9A6A00)right-click[#]() a [#](1F5F99)**black cat**[#]() with a die.\
\
The die shows [#](C0392B)**1**[#](): the cat becomes a Mistigri.

- Meeting its gaze: [#](C0392B)**Bad Luck**[#]() 1 min
- Hitting it: 2 min, and it gets angry
- [#](1F5F99)**Raw fish**[#]() calms it

- Knocks items off frames
- Sleeps on chests: [#](C0392B)**locked**[#]() while it sleeps
- Drops the [#](1F5F99)**Mistigri's Die**[#]()

[#](1F5F99)**Raw fish**[#](): 6 to 10.

- It follows you
- [#](2E7D32)**Luck**[#]() within 16 blocks
- Monsters miss 1 hit in 3
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.trichaud: A three-headed Nether turtle, a lava tank on its back.

- Empty bucket: [#](C0392B)**-1**[#]() lava bucket
- Lava bucket: [#](2E7D32)**+1**[#]()
- It drinks lava to refill

[#](1F5F99)**Neutral**[#](): when hit, each head aims, [#](C0392B)locks its aim[#](), then spits.\
\
Dodge at the last moment, or raise a [#](1F5F99)**shield**[#]().

[#](C0392B)**Empty**[#]() its tank with buckets, then ride it.\
\
Empty: [#](2E7D32)**70%%**[#]() on the first try. [#](2E7D32)**+10%%**[#]() per failure.

- A [#](1F5F99)**saddle**[#](), up to 3 players
- Each holds a head
- Everyone's keys add up
- Its lava is its fuel

- Hold [#](9A6A00)jump[#](), release: a 15-block leap
- In the air, [#](9A6A00)click[#](): it grabs a wall
book.steveparty.guide.creatures.wickling: A candle ghost of the caves

A candle ghost of deep caves.\
\
No monster within [#](2E7D32)**8 blocks**[#]().

It steals [#](C0392B)**a shiny item**[#]() from whoever passes within 2 blocks.\
\
Never from someone with a torch, a lantern, or a Wickling.

- Hits: it reappears further away
- Projectiles: hurt it
- [#](1F5F99)**Flint and steel**[#](): gives the loot back, then tamed [#](2E7D32)**1 in 3**[#]()

- It lights the dark for you
- Cobwebs: no more slowdown
- [#](9A6A00)Sneak + click[#]() on it sitting: [#](1F5F99)**Candle Holder**[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.buildin:
Two families, 8 shapes per colour: **Polished Terracotta** (17 colours) and **Polished Concrete** (16): block, bevelled bricks, stairs, slab, wall, and the brick versions.\
\
2×2 terracotta or concrete gives 4 polished blocks; 2×2 polished gives 4 bricks. The stonecutter skips steps.
Two polished blocks of different colours in a 2×2 checkerboard give 4 **Polished Tiles** (concrete or terracotta). Swap the colours for the shifted pattern; the stonecutter makes single-colour tiles.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.floatin:
Plastic blocks rise through still water and ride **bubble columns** (up on soul sand, down on magma), carrying whatever stands on them, without ever crushing anyone.\
\
A block over soul sand makes a fast water elevator. A **chain** holds a piece in place. Slabs, stairs and walls never float.
A wooden drum hammer loaded with **9 stencils and 9 dyes**. **Left-click** opens its wheel: colours on one side, stencils on the other, *Engrave* (no paint, signs only) and, at the top, its **inventory** to load them. A pick applies at once.\
\
**Right-click** to **stamp**: a drum thud, a paint splash and the pattern printed, 1 dye per hit.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.hop_swi:
Makes target blocks **disappear or appear** for a while. Link the targets: right-click each with a Cartridge and put it in the switch, or paint them with the brush. Jump on it or power it: it stays down for the duration, then pops back up and **launches** whoever stands on it.\
\
Modes: toggle, appear, disappear. A **clock** changes the duration (sneak: shorter).
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.name: Decoration & Gadgets
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.paintin:
- Dye alone: repaints the symbol.
- Glow ink sac: the paint glows at night.
- Sponge: stops the glow.
- Wet sponge: erases everything.
- Brush (held): fades the symbol, gone after 5 strokes.

Paint on walls, floors and ceilings is a thin layer that hitting can't break.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.pipes.p:
Travel pipes. Placed against a pipe or its mouth, they connect. Enter a mouth (right-click, sneak in front of it, or fall in): you shoot through and come out of another end at random.\
\
A pipe going into a solid block teleports to the nearest mouth of that colour within 100 blocks.
6 plastic blocks, or 4 + 2 glass for a windowed pipe. Glass pipes: 6 glass.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.plastic:
4 Plastic Pellets + 1 dye + 1 amethyst shard give 4 blocks. Neighbouring blocks of the same colour merge into a single piece (up to 4×2×4).\
\
The Wrench breaks plastic in one hit; shears are fast too.

- **Plastic Stud**: 1 block gives 4; sticks to floor, wall or ceiling, needs no support.
- **Slabs, stairs, walls**: usual recipes or the stonecutter.
- **Plastic Stick**: 2 blocks give 4.
- **Fence**: blocks and sticks; it carries road signs.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.signs.p:
Panels and road signs: sneak-click the top of a fence or wall to stand on it, click its side to hang it, any other face to lay it flat.\
\
Material recipes need the **same** block everywhere: no half-oak, half-birch sign.
A plastic block over pellets gives 2. Off a post, it floats like plastic.
book.steveparty.guide.decoration.stencil:
Right-click it with a stencil, then again to open the editor: left-click cuts a pixel, right-click fills it, drag to draw lines. Flip, rotate, invert, undo.\
\
Your **library** (128 patterns, kept on death) learns every patterned stencil you carry. Click a pattern to copy it for free.

A **Stencil** holds a 16x16 pattern. Stencil in one hand, dye in the other: right-click a sign or any full block face to paint it (1 dye). A stencil alone **engraves** a sign. The stencil is never used up.\
\
Copy one with blank stencils. 50 patterns can be found in structure chests.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.bubbler.pa:
Step on it (sneak to cross it), or drop an item on it: you're trapped in a **soap bubble** that rises 30 blocks (powered: 2 per redstone level), then floats. Its small bubbles show how high.\
\
Above the Bubbler, up to that height, the bubble never pops on contact.

Hold **jump** to charge a puff, release: the bubble shoots **where you look**, about 15 blocks (more upwards). Movement keys drift it slowly.\
\
Puffs in quick succession **strain** it: it swells, turns pink-red, quivers and creaks, and the next puff may pop it. A few calm seconds relax it.

Attack or sneak from inside: you're out. Outside the column it pops on any **block**, mob, player or vehicle, after **15 s** without moving, or crossing a mini-game zone's border. A hit pushes it (1 in 4 pops it; never with Silk Touch), an arrow pops it, a **snowball** only pushes it.\
\
On popping: Slow Falling.

Two occupied bubbles that touch **merge** (8 riders max), everyone's keys shared.\
\
What a rider shoots or throws from inside goes through the bubble and becomes bubbly: the creature it hits also gets **Bubbled**, trapped in its own bubble until it pops. Bosses are immune.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.looting_bo:
Open it with the Wrench: its slot takes an **Inventory Cartridge**, whose menu shows beside it (items, amounts, mode). Link its chests with the cartridge or the brush.\
\
Jump and **headbutt** it from below: it drops items from the chests (all, next or random). Two hits, then 3 s of rest. Leave 2-3 blocks of air below it.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.plunger.pa: Right-click a mob: silenced! Again: it gets its voice back.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.shoes.name: Triple Jump Shoes
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.shoes.page: Jump again while running right after landing: the 2nd jump goes ×1.5 higher, the 3rd ×2, then the cycle starts over. In the air, jump into a wall to slide down it, then jump to kick off it towards where you look. With the Double Jump enchantment: one more jump in the air.
Leather boots, a rabbit's foot and 2 slime balls.
book.steveparty.guide.gadgets.villager_m:
A Villager Block reacts to about 70 things with 16 faces: it waves when you arrive, blushes when stared at, drools when you eat, panics at zombies, dances to a jukebox (wild on Pigstep), begs when you break it…\
\
Give it bread or a flower, or click it 10 times quickly and watch it see stars.
book.steveparty.guide.getting_started.fi: Six steps to a working board

1. Lay [#](1F5F99)**Tiles**[#]() as a path
2. Link them with the [#](1F5F99)**Linker Brush**[#]()
3. One tile with a [#](4C9A2A)**Start Cartridge**[#]()
4. A mob as a token: [#](1F5F99)**Tokenizer Wand**[#]()
5. A [#](1F5F99)**Party Controller**[#](): [#](9A6A00)Start the party[#]()
6. Roll a [#](1F5F99)**die**[#]()!

Each step has its tab: [#](1F5F99)**The board**[#](), [#](1F5F99)**Cartridges**[#](), [#](1F5F99)**Tokens and dice**[#](), [#](1F5F99)**Running a party**[#]().\
\
The rest whenever you like.
book.steveparty.guide.getting_started.pl: The first ingredient of almost everything

The first ingredient of almost everything.\
\
[#](1F5F99)**Sugar cane**[#]() in a furnace = pellets.
Start a sugar cane farm early!
book.steveparty.guide.getting_started.we: What Steve Party Maker is about

Build a [#](1F5F99)**board**[#](), turn mobs into [#](1F5F99)**tokens**[#](), roll the [#](1F5F99)**dice**[#]() and win [#](B8900A)**stars**[#]().\
\
In survival, and nearly all of it with redstone.

- Entries open as you play
- A [#](C0392B)locked[#]() entry says how to open it
- Every item: the mod's creative tab
book.steveparty.guide.lock.dice_forge: Place a Dice Forge to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.lay_the_board: Place a Tile to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.make_a_pawn: Get a Tokenizer Wand or a Token to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.mini_games: Get a Mini-Game Page or place a Mini-game Controller to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.open_shop: Get a Shopkeeper Key or place a Trading Stall to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.party_time: Place a Party Controller to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.roll_the_dice: Get a die to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.lock.stardust: Get a star fragment to unlock this entry.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.entranc:
A **Mini-game Pipe** is the way into a mini-game outside a party. Click it with the page to program it, then connect coloured pipes: enter by a green mouth to come out as a player, by a white one as a spectator…\
\
Range: **copper** 100 blocks, **iron** the whole dimension, **golden** every dimension.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.formats:
A page lists its formats: **Teams** (2 to 4 sides, sizes from-to), **Free for all** or **All together**. Names build themselves: Duel, 2 vs 2, 1 vs all…\
\
In a party, teams come from the board: **Team A** = pawns on a positive (blue) space, **Team B** = on a negative (red) one; neutral ones fill in. Only pages with a fitting format can be drawn.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.mg_cont:
Place it in the arena and click it with the page. Its lamp shows the state: **red** idle, **orange** practice round, **green** real round.\
\
Outside a party, **Play** starts the mini-game with the players within 5 blocks of its pipes; no rewards are paid. A redstone pulse plays, the next one stops.

In a party, a mini-game with a controller starts with a **practice round**: same teams, no rewards. It restarts until everyone is ready: press **Y** or the *Ready* button. Then the real round begins.\
\
Turn practice off in the Party Controller settings.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.name: Mini-games
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.pages.p:
A **Mini-Game Page** describes one mini-game. Right-click in the air to open its editor: title, description, image, then the **Formats**, **Pipes** and **Results** tabs.\
\
Keep pages in a **Mini Games Catalogue** (91 slots) and put it in the Party Controller. A page + paper makes a linked copy.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.podiums:
Podiums record **who won**: the higher the column, the better the place. Sneak on one or right-click it to take it. Link podiums to the page (click with the page): the mini-game ends when every place is taken.\
\
Placed like slabs, they stack into columns. During a linked mini-game, columns of the same height share one place.

A redstone pulse in a column does what the Wrench set: register the nearest player (default), give the best free place, clear it, or reset the group. Comparator: 15 while taken.\
\
A Goal Pole Base touching a podium becomes the group's counter.
Gold, silver and bronze podiums are only looks.
book.steveparty.guide.mini_games.zone.pa:
In the page editor, *Draw zone* and right-click two corners (128 blocks per side at most). With the **Restore** option, each round is played apart in that zone: players leave their inventory at the door and play with an empty one, nothing crosses the border, and the arena is rebuilt afterwards.\
\
*Adventure* stops players from breaking or placing blocks.
book.steveparty.guide.name: Steve Party Maker Guide
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.name: Party Bell
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.page0.t:
Redstone at the right moment.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#](): when it rings.
book.steveparty.guide.party.bell.page1.t:
Party, round or turn start · die rolled · mini-game · Event card · end.\
\
Comparator: a related number (roll, rank…).\
\
[#](1F5F99)**Wait**[#]() mode: the party waits for a signal.
book.steveparty.guide.party.cards.name: Party Cards
Your program, [#](1F5F99)**Program**[#]() tab, left to right.
- [#](1F5F99)**Turns**[#](): each token plays once
- [#](1F5F99)**Mini-game**[#](): one from the catalogue
- [#](1F5F99)**Event**[#](): rings the Event bells
- [#](1F5F99)**Repeat**[#](): replays from the [#](1F5F99)**Sequence start**[#]()
Stud of the colour + paper + redstone = 4 cards.
book.steveparty.guide.party.controller.p: It runs the party. [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#](): its dashboard.

- [#](1F5F99)**Status**[#](): what's missing, then the live party
- [#](1F5F99)**Players**[#](): tokens, stars, coins
- [#](1F5F99)**Program**[#](): mini-games and cards
- [#](1F5F99)**Gains**[#]() · [#](1F5F99)**Storage**[#]() · [#](1F5F99)**Settings**[#]()

It takes the tokens bound to a [#](4C9A2A)**Start**[#]() within 100 blocks.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Start the party[#](), or a redstone signal.

[#](9A6A00)Stop the party[#]() (Status tab, two clicks): ends it [#](C0392B)**with no winner**[#](), tokens back to start.\
\
Operator or Game Master.

On: only the dice in its slots can be rolled.\
\
[#](9A6A00)Click[#]() with a die: added. Empty hand: removed.
Comparator: 0 idle, 1 setup, 2 turn, 3 mini-game, 4 bell, 5 end.
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.descrip: From the first roll to the podium
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.name: How a Party Plays
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.page0.t:
1. Bound tokens join
2. One roll each: highest starts
3. Your turn: roll, move
4. Then a mini-game
5. End: tokens are freed
book.steveparty.guide.party.flow.page1.t:
A missing token: its turn waits 60 s, then [#](9A6A00)[Skip the turn][#]() or [#](9A6A00)[Exclude from the party][#]().\
\
[#](9A6A00)M[#]() arranges the HUD, [#](9A6A00)H[#]() hides it.
book.steveparty.guide.party.goal_pole.de: Jump to the top and score
book.steveparty.guide.party.goal_pole.pa: Land on top: [#](2E7D32)**+1 ♥**[#]() and a point.

- A [#](1F5F99)**Goal Pole Base**[#]()
- [#](1F5F99)**Goal Pole**[#]() segments on it
- The [#](1F5F99)**Flag**[#]() goes to the top

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() the pole: the goal.\
\
Reached, the flag comes down. Dye: colour. Shears: removed.

- Comparator on the base: a pulse per point
- Against the pole: progress 0 to 15
- Signal into the base: pause; 15: reset
3 wool in a corner; 1 to 8 dyes change it.
book.steveparty.guide.party.name: Running a Party
book.steveparty.guide.party.piggy_bank.d: Give and take on a pulse
book.steveparty.guide.party.piggy_bank.p: On each pulse: its [#](B95D05)**Inventory Cartridge**[#]() [#](2E7D32)**gives**[#]() or [#](C0392B)**takes**[#]().

[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#](): its menu.
- the player whose turn it is
- the last winners
- everyone
- the nearest
book.steveparty.guide.party.powerups.pag:
[#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() at the start of your turn, [#](C0392B)before your roll[#]().\
\
[#](1F5F99)**One**[#]() per turn.

- [#](1F5F99)**Mushroom**[#](): [#](2E7D32)**+3**[#]() to the roll
- [#](1F5F99)**Double Coins**[#](): gains [#](2E7D32)**×2**[#]()
- [#](1F5F99)**Padlock**[#](): blocks a theft or a trap

- [#](1F5F99)**Thief Bell**[#](): steals [#](C0392B)**5 to 15**[#]() coins
- [#](1F5F99)**Golden Thief Bell**[#](): steals [#](C0392B)**1 star**[#]()
- [#](1F5F99)**Trap**[#](): set on your space, the next one [#](C0392B)**pays you**[#]()

[#](9A6A00)Sneak + right-click[#](): write and sign it.\
\
Coins stolen, move back, turn lost or item stolen.

- [#](1F5F99)**Star Whistle**[#](): the star moves
- [#](1F5F99)**Golden Pipe**[#](): your token right [#](2E7D32)**before the star**[#]()

[#](1F5F99)**3**[#]() power-ups carried at most ([#](1F5F99)**Max power-ups**[#](), Settings).\
\
Dice with the power-up module count too.

Easy to craft. The board's maker sells them: stall, [#](5E8C0F)**Shop**[#]() space, [#](B95D05)**Inventory**[#]() space…\
\
Suggested prices: [#](1F5F99)**5**[#]() to [#](1F5F99)**40**[#]() coins.
book.steveparty.guide.party.rewards.name: Coins, Stars & Rewards
book.steveparty.guide.party.rewards.page:
A player's coins and stars are those [#](1F5F99)**items**[#]() in their inventory.\
\
Ranking: stars, then coins.

By default: the [#](1F5F99)**Coin**[#]() and the [#](B8900A)**Party Star**[#]().\
\
[#](1F5F99)**Gains**[#]() tab: [#](9A6A00)click[#]() their slot with an item to change them.

[#](1F5F99)**Storage**[#]() tab: 27 slots, plus its linked chests.

- What the party [#](2E7D32)**pays**[#]() comes out of it
- What it [#](C0392B)**takes**[#]() goes back in
- [#](C0392B)Empty: nothing is paid[#]()
book.steveparty.guide.party.step_control:
- Turn not rolled: skipped / replayed
- Bell waiting: released
- Trial round: the real one / again
- Mini-game: ended / restarted

Linked with the [#](1F5F99)**Linker Brush**[#]() to a part of a party: that party, even far away.\
\
Else: the nearest within 64 blocks.
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.dice.pa:
Right-click: the die flies to the **nearest mob** within 20 blocks (sneak: the nearest **player**), floats above its head and spins. **Hit** it to stop it; Double and Triple Dice fall one after the other.\
\
The result moves one of the thrower's pawns. In a party, only the pawn whose turn it is, and **one throw per roll**: another die is refused.

- **Simple Die**: 1 to 10.
- **Double Dice**: two linked dice, 2 to 20.
- **Triple Dice**: three, 3 to 30.
- **Forged Die**: its own faces, from the Dice Forge.

A thrown die vanishes 2 s after its result and comes back to you (a Power-up die is spent).
Dice come out of the **Dice Forge**. Combine them for bigger ones; they split back.
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.faces.p:
Faces are only used in the **Dice Forge**. 2 iron ingots + 2 nether quartz give 4 **Blank Dice Faces**; the **stonecutter** turns a blank face into any number (0 to 10, premium or cursed) and back.\
\
On a forged die, a blank face is a 0.

- **Face 0**: stay put and replay the current space.
- **Coin +1 to +10**: the thrower gains coins.
- **Debt −1 to −10**: the thrower loses coins.
- **Swap**: swap places with another player's pawn.

With these faces, the pawn does not move.
Blank face + ender pearl, or + a Coin. Debt: blank face + spider eye.
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.game_ma:
A treasure enchantment for the Tokenizer Wand only, found in woodland mansion chests (25%%), or dropped by evokers (5%%) and illusioners (25%%) killed by a player.\
\
With it, the wand resizes anyone's pawn and can `/steveparty exclude` any pawn of a party within 100 blocks. Operators already have these rights.
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.name: Pawns & Dice
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.pawns.p:
A pawn is a figurine: no AI, silent, invulnerable, it can't be pushed or leashed, and feeding or trading does nothing.\
\
Its name is the mob's custom name, or yours. Its colour comes from the mob's texture and tints its octagonal base; right-click it with a dye to change it. Cast the spell on your own pawn again to resize it.
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.token.p:
The **Token** is how you move a pawn by hand. Right-click your pawn with an empty Token to store it; right-click a block with the full Token to set it down, size, owner and colour kept.\
\
Set it on a start space to enter it in the party.
Plastic Pellets and a shulker box.
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.wand.de: Any mob can be a pawn
book.steveparty.guide.pawns_dice.wand.pa:
Right-click a mob with the **Tokenizer Wand** (or hold right-click in the air to shoot a spark up to 32 blocks): the *Pionificus!* spell opens.\
\
Draw a circle around the mob: on the guide = a 1-block pawn, twice as big = 2 blocks (max), smaller = smaller, down to 0.25. Esc cancels. Not on the Ender Dragon or the Wither.
Wand: Lapis Crystal Ball, gold block, blaze rod. Ball: lapis lazuli blocks around a Party Star.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.bandanas.pag:
Each trader wears one of 5 bandanas. **Shears** on an open trader steal it, and it hides for 20 s. Wearing a bandana, traders ignore you. Give one back to change a trader's colour.\
\
Shear a bald trader again to steal its box look: a **Box Costume**. Wear it like a chestplate, and sneak to hide inside as a real-looking block.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.name: Shops
book.steveparty.guide.shops.overview.boa:
Shops built this way are free trade between players, with no purchase limit; they play no part in a party.\
\
On the board, a **Shop Cartridge** brings its own trader (see *Cartridges*). A real Trading Stall right in front of its Spawn Bubble shows its offers during the stop.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.overview.pag: A star fragment of any colour, a gold ingot and a gold nugget, in a column.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.owners.name: Owners & Protection
book.steveparty.guide.shops.owners.page0:
The first player to link a key to a trader **owns** it. Only the owner can link blocks, open the stall and register, open the stock chests or break the shop's blocks; explosions spare them.\
\
One customer at a time. Hoppers can fill the stock chests and empty the registers.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.register.pag:
27 slots. After each sale, the payment goes into the linked registers, in order; if they're full, it drops near the trader, never destroyed. Each sale sends a 4-tick redstone pulse from every linked register.\
\
Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.stall.name: Trading Stall
Each column is an offer (9 at most): the item sold on top, **Price 1** and **Price 2** below. Prices must match exactly.\
\
The top item is only a model: each sale takes the same item **from the linked chests**. Without stock, the offer is greyed out.
The two carpets give the awning its colours.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.trader.descr: A villager hidden in a box
book.steveparty.guide.shops.trader.name: Boxed Trader
book.steveparty.guide.shops.trader.page0:
A villager hidden in a box disguised as a block. It peeks out when a player comes within 15 blocks (sneaking players don't wake it); a leash keeps it closed.\
\
Without a shop it wanders up to 16 blocks around; once a key is linked, it stays put. Killed, it forgets its owner and links.
book.steveparty.guide.shops.villager_blo: A **piston facing down** that extends onto an adult villager's head squashes it into a **Villager Block**: alive, keeping its trades and job, with about 70 reactions. A sticky piston pulls the villager back out.

Put the Villager Block **on the block to imitate**, then **fall on it** from high enough: 10 + 4 × that block's hardness (hay 12, stone 16, planks 18). A **Boxed Trader** pops out, disguised as that block.\
\
The squashed villager's own trades don't carry over.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.dice_fo: Party Star, obsidian, a blast furnace and a netherite ingot.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.ephemer:
A night of shooting stars, rolled once per night at dusk: 25%% on a full moon, less as the moon wanes, none on a new moon. Guaranteed on a full moon near a max-level Dice Forge.\
\
6 waves of stars cross the sky above each player. After the first one, a group of **3-5 Mulas** lands **150-600 blocks** away, in the direction the stars went.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.forging:
Click the arrow between the blank faces and the die (**FORGE**): one die every 5 s, in a loop, while ingredients last. Each die uses its blank faces and one fragment per non-black slot.\
\
Hoppers fill it (top and sides) and take dice out from below. Powered = production on. A comparator reads the output.

A **Forged Die** rolls one of its own faces, weighted: a face carved 10 times comes up 10 times as often. A single face makes a loaded die.\
\
Forged dice with the same faces stack and can make a Double or Triple Dice.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.fragmen: 9 fragments make a glowing, glass-like block that breaks back into 9.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.gravity:
Placed, it glows and **pulls** everything within 8 blocks into an orbit, without fall damage; full iron armour (or heavier) resists. Mulas and pawns are never pulled. **Sneak** to move slower in its orbit (it does not let go); it breaks by hand and drops itself.\
\
Its real job: waking up the **Dice Forge**.
Crying obsidian, 4 black star fragments and a heavy core.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.mula.pa:
It falls from the sky on [#](1F5F99)**Ephemeris**[#]() nights, or hatches from an egg.\
\
[#](2A62C9)**Blue**[#](), [#](C0392B)**red**[#](), [#](2E7D32)**green**[#](), [#](B8900A)**yellow**[#](), [#](8E4BFF)**violet**[#](); rarely [#](23202A)**black**[#]().

Only food of [#](1F5F99)**its colour**[#]() (see the tooltip).\
\
Full (40), it [#](2E7D32)**bursts**[#](): [#](2E7D32)**64 star fragments**[#](), then is reborn further away.
On a [#](B8900A)**Star**[#]() space, a Mula holds the star and hands it to the token that arrives.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.mula_ho:
A forge with its core becomes the **home** of every Mula within 16 blocks. They stay around it and **dance** together around the core: ten figures of 26 s each, from the Carousel of Stars to the Heartbeat Nova.\
\
A Mula bursting at home loops back and lands 2-4 blocks from the forge. Explode the core and they all scatter, without fragments.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.name: Stars & Creatures
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.party_s:
A rare, always shining item: one fragment each of **blue, green, yellow, red and purple**, or **5 black** fragments.\
\
It crowns the Dice Forge recipe and is the default **Star** of a party.
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.rising_:
The core rises with the fragments inside: 16 blocks × fragments / 320 (a black one counts as 64). With all 5 slots full, it is at the top: the forge is at **max level** and guarantees an Ephemeride on full moon nights.\
\
The raised core pulls things into orbit (up to 32 blocks). Hit it and it **explodes**: no block broken, but the core is lost. Sneak with an empty hand to take it back safely.
A fragment of [#](1F5F99)**its colour**[#](): [#](2E7D32)**1 chance in 3**[#]().

- Follows you like a balloon
- [#](9A6A00)Right-click[#]() empty-handed: sits
- At night, on a [#](1F5F99)**lead**[#](), they lift you into the sky
book.steveparty.guide.stars_mula.telesco: Replays past Ephemeride nights. At night, under a clear sky, right-click it: scroll to pick a night, then keep a shooting star in the crosshair until the gauge fills. A **guide star** then lights up above the spot where the Mulas landed.
book.steveparty.guide.tooltip: Build a board, run a party, tame a Mula.
